records.reason: Free-action spellshape: skipping the slot expenditure for the next spell is resolved at the table when the spell is cast.
Triggered free action that lowers a target creature's mythic resistance (or adds precision damage to one Strike against it); changes only the target's side of a roll.

The player permanently lays claim to one of three domains (confidence, secrecy, or trickery); nothing records that pick. The Lie timing, mythic-proficiency Deception and worshipper effects are table-side.

effectChoices.prompt: Myth of Quick-Thinking — choose the domain you lay claim to

records.reason: An action that spends a Mythic Point to swap in mythic proficiency for one spell; resolved at the table when that spell is cast.
An activity that traps a target creature; everything it does lands on the target's statistics.
Changes the proficiency and failure degree of a counteract check made at the table; no sheet value changes.
Reaction resolved at the table (expend a slot, attempt a counteract check).
A 1-action Mythic Point spend that refills the focus pool; the player just fills the Focus Point pips. refocusRestore covers only 'whenever you Refocus', which this is not.
An action: one Strike made at mythic proficiency counting as a mythic weapon; resolved at the table.
Only applies to Strikes made at mythic proficiency (a per-action Mythic Point spend the app does not track), so no static sheet number changes.
Changes how an ALLY (the hero of your tale) measures range and cover; nothing on your own sheet.
Extra Hit Points and faster doomed/fatigued recovery only when taking full rest in a specific natural body of water; a rest/downtime adjudication the app does not model.
Spellshape that moves a spell's origin point to an animal; resolved at the table.
A degree-of-success upgrade on Survival checks to Sense Direction or Track, applied when the die is rolled; no sheet value changes.
Makes hunted prey off-guard to you (target-side) and lets you Avoid Notice/Sneak at full Speed — an exploration adjudication.
Adds precision damage to the player's own animal companion's unarmed Strikes; nothing is recorded on the companion. The COMPANION_MODS lane exists for exactly this.

companionMod.note: Nature's Precision: when your companion Strikes an off-guard creature with an agile or finesse unarmed attack, it deals an extra 1d4 precision damage (2d4 if the companion is specialized). If it already deals precision damage, combine the two.

records.reason: A degree-of-success upgrade on saves against necromancy effects, applied when the save is rolled; it changes no save modifier on the sheet.
Spellshape that adds damage to an undead TARGET's attacks after you heal it; nothing lands on your sheet.
A two-action activity (Leap and Strike twice with deferred MAP) resolved at the table.
A reaction that reduces incoming damage on one trigger; not a standing resistance.
A reaction that delays the fatigued condition; condition timing adjudicated at the table.
An action combining Leap and reloading; resolved at the table.
Extends the Retributive Strike reaction (ranged option, Step first); reaction handling is table-side.
Hand-economy permission (the shield hand counts as free for Interact); no statistic changes.
Adds a Strike to the Nimble Dodge reaction, outside the multiple attack penalty; resolved at the table.
A reaction that lets you Unleash your Psyche or use a psyche action off-turn; resolved at the table.
A reaction to Stride (or Climb/Fly/Swim/Burrow) after a fleeing foe; resolved at the table.
Folds Cover Tracks into the Avoid Notice exploration activity; the app does not model exploration activities.

Grants telekinetic hand as an at-will innate cantrip (arcane or occult, player's choice); the feat carries no innateSpells and the spell never reaches the Spells page. The +5 ft Interact reach is table-side.

effectChoices.prompt: No Hands, No Problems — choose the tradition of your at-will telekinetic hand

records.reason: A per-Strike declaration to add the nonlethal trait to a ranged weapon; chosen at the table, no static change.
A reaction that attempts a counteract check against a fear effect on you or an ally; resolved at the table.
A reaction that moves a knight and takes damage in their place; movement and damage swap are table-side.
Hit Points regained after a 10-minute rest; a rest/downtime recovery the app does not compute.
Spellshape that adds the nonlethal trait to the next damaging spell; resolved at the table.
Removes the -2 circumstance penalty for attacking nonlethally with a lethal weapon — a per-Strike declaration the app never applies in the first place.
An action designating one creature; the extra damage die applies once per round against that designated foe at the table.
Downtime-mode Long-Term Rest and Subsist benefits; the app does not model downtime activities.
An action (Stride without provoking, gain concealment, foes off-guard until end of turn); resolved at the table.
Adds the sickened condition to creatures that fail against your Emit Defensive Odor action; entirely target-side.

During daily preparations the player chooses life or death; choosing death gives them the void healing ability (they become healable by void effects). Nothing records the pick. The healing itself targets another creature. Note: EffectGrant has no negativeHealing key, so the option can only record the choice.

effectChoices.prompt: Nudge the Scales — during daily preparations, place yourself on one side of the scales. Death gives you void healing (healed by void effects instead of vitality); the app cannot flip your healing type automatically.

options.label: Life — healed by vitality effects, as a normal living creature
Death — you gain void healing and are healed by void effects

records.reason: An additive that modifies an alchemical food item; the granted breath action belongs to whoever consumes it and is resolved at the table.
An edict plus the option to use Lay on Hands offensively against an invoked creature; all of it lands on the target.

A daily pick of an enemy kind, and +1 spirit damage (2 at 7th, 3 at 14th) on your Strikes and damaging devotion spells against creatures of that kind. Nothing records the pick or the conditional damage.

effectChoices.prompt: Oath of the Slayer — during daily preparations, swear to defeat one kind of enemy (not celestials if you are holy, not fiends if you are unholy)

situational.when: vs your sworn kind (2 at 7th, 3 at 14th; doubled after your reaction)
damaging devotion spells vs your sworn kind (2 at 7th, 3 at 14th)

records.reason: Grants concealment for a round after you stop being hidden; a transient combat state, not a sheet value.
Replaces the effects of a spell you cast on an area; it changes the battlefield, not your sheet.
Lets you attempt Perception checks to notice hidden creatures without Searching; an exploration adjudication.
Changes the damage dice or area of the Emit Defensive Odor action; entirely target-side, chosen per use.
Widens Commitment to Protection to all allies within 30 feet; affects allies only.
An action forcing a save on a grabbed foe; all effects land on the target.
Retraining: it swaps one impulse feat, which the builder already lets the player change.
Death-defiance gated on a living knight within 30 feet plus a once-a-year resurrection; a narrative/GM adjudication, not a flat dying-threshold change.
An action that preps an Aid for an ally and lets you roll Diplomacy for it; the benefit lands on the ally's check.
An activity: one unarmed Strike with extra damage dice scaled by the actions spent, chosen at the table.
Narrative death/resurrection and body-sharing with your united companion; GM-adjudicated.
Adds a forced-movement save to One-Inch Punch; entirely target-side.
Ignoring difficult terrain, circumstance penalties, and environmental concealment in your bound terrain; a per-scene GM adjudication.
Permission to Hide and Sneak without cover or concealment in natural terrain; adjudicated at the table.
Implants a suggestion in a TARGET's mind during Infiltrate Dream; nothing on your sheet.
Exploration-activity permission (full Speed while Investigating, plus a second exploration activity); the app does not model exploration activities.
Resistance that exists only after the Selfish Shield reaction fires, only against that one enemy, only until end of turn; a reaction follow-up resolved at the table, not a standing resistance.
